about.subheadline: STENMED BIOTECH operates at the forefront of pharmaceutical distribution and marketing.
about.story: Founded with a vision to deliver world-class therapeutic solutions, STENMED BIOTECH bridges clinical excellence and ethical healthcare distribution. Headquartered in Greater Noida, UP, we supply a wide spectrum of certified pharmaceuticals across Pediatric, Gynecological, Gastrointestinal, and Physician specialties.
about.mission: To enhance human health and well-being by ensuring uninterrupted access to safe, genuine, and high-quality pharmaceutical formulations.
about.vision: To be recognized as the most trusted healthcare distribution brand nationwide, known for integrity, rapid supply chain, and clinical excellence.

faqs.q: How can I place an institutional or bulk order with STENMED BIOTECH?
faqs.a: You can connect directly with our sales team via WhatsApp (+91 74173 50021), call our helpline, or submit an inquiry on our Contact page with your drug license and requirement list.

faqs.q: Are all products manufactured under WHO-GMP compliance?
faqs.a: Yes, 100% of our product portfolio is produced in certified WHO-GMP and ISO compliant pharmaceutical manufacturing plants with batch-level quality control testing.

faqs.q: What therapeutic categories does STENMED BIOTECH cover?
faqs.a: Our core divisions specialize in Pediatrics, Gynecologist/Women's Health, Gastroenterology, Hepatology (Liver Care), Pulmonology, and General Physician medicines.

faqs.q: What is the expected dispatch and delivery turnaround time?
faqs.a: Stock orders are typically processed and dispatched within 24 to 48 hours with real-time consignment tracking.
